text.description: The text content to display. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g., '/doc/title'). While simple Markdown formatting is supported (i.e. without HTML, images, or links), utilizing dedicated UI components is generally preferred for a richer and more structured presentation.

usageHint.description: A hint for the base text style. One of: - `h1`: Largest heading. - `h2`: Second largest heading. - `h3`: Third largest heading. - `h4`: Fourth largest heading. - `h5`: Fifth largest heading. - `caption`: Small text for captions. - `body`: Standard body text.

url.description: The URL of the image to display. This can be a literal string ('literal') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/thumbnail/url').

altText.description: The alt text for the image. This can be a literal string ('literal') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/thumbnail/altText').

fit.description: Specifies how the image should be resized to fit its container. This corresponds to the CSS 'object-fit' property.

usageHint.description: A hint for the image size and style. One of: - `icon`: Small square icon. - `avatar`: Circular avatar image. - `smallFeature`: Small feature image. - `mediumFeature`: Medium feature image. - `largeFeature`: Large feature image. - `header`: Full-width, full bleed, header image.

url.description: The URL of the video to display. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/video/url').

description.description: A description of the audio, such as a title or summary. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/song/title').

distribution.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (horizontally). This corresponds to the CSS 'justify-content' property.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (vertically). This corresponds to the CSS 'align-items' property.

distribution.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). This corresponds to the CSS 'justify-content' property.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This corresponds to the CSS 'align-items' property.

direction.description: The direction in which the list items are laid out.

alignment.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis.

child.description: The ID of the component to be rendered inside the card.

tabItems.description: An array of objects, where each object defines a tab with a title and a child component.

entryPointChild.description: The ID of the component that opens the modal when interacted with (e.g., a button).

contentChild.description: The ID of the component to be displayed inside the modal.

child.description: The ID of the component to display in the button, typically a Text component.

primary.description: Indicates if this button should be styled as the primary action.

label.description: The text to display next to the checkbox. Defines the value as either a literal value or a path to data model ('path', e.g. '/option/label').

value.description: The current state of the checkbox (true for checked, false for unchecked). This can be a literal boolean ('literalBoolean') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/filter/open').

label.description: The text label for the input field. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path, e.g. '/user/name').

text.description: The value of the text field. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/user/name').

textFieldType.description: The type of input field to display.

validationRegexp.description: A regular expression used for client-side validation of the input.

value.description: The selected date and/or time value in ISO 8601 format. This can be a literal string ('literalString') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/user/dob').

enableDate.description: If true, allows the user to select a date.

enableTime.description: If true, allows the user to select a time.

options.description: An array of available options for the user to choose from.

maxAllowedSelections.description: The maximum number of options that the user is allowed to select.

variant.description: The display style of the component.

filterable.description: If true, displays a search input to filter the options.

label.description: The label for the slider. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path').

minValue.description: The minimum value of the slider.

maxValue.description: The maximum value of the slider.

font.description: The primary font for the UI.

primaryColor.description: The primary UI color as a hexadecimal code (e.g., '#00BFFF').

ComponentId.description: The unique identifier for a component, used for both definitions and references within the same surface.

TextItem.description: The value of the text field. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/user/name').

AltTextItem.description: The alt text for the image. This can be a literal string ('literal') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/thumbnail/altText').

UrlItem.description: The URL of the audio to be played. This can be a literal string ('literal') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/song/url').

NameItem.description: The name of the icon to display. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/form/submit').

DescriptionItem.description: A description of the audio, such as a title or summary. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/song/title').

ChildrenItem.description: Defines the children. Use 'explicitList' for a fixed set of children, or 'template' to generate children from a data list.

template.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. `componentId` is the component to use as a template, and `dataBinding` is the path to the map of components in the data model. Values in the map will define the list of children.

TemplateItem.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. `componentId` is the component to use as a template, and `dataBinding` is the path to the map of components in the data model. Values in the map will define the list of children.

TitleItem.description: The tab title. Defines the value as either a literal value or a path to data model value (e.g. '/options/title').

ActionItem.description: The client-side action to be dispatched when the button is clicked. It includes the action's name and an optional context payload.

value.description: Defines the value to be included in the context as either a literal value or a path to a data model value (e.g. '/user/name').

ValueItem.description: The current value of the slider. This can be a literal number ('literalNumber') or a reference to a value in the data model ('path', e.g. '/restaurant/cost').

LabelItem.description: The label for the slider. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model ('path').

label.description: The text to display for this option. This can be a literal string or a reference to a value in the data model (e.g. '/option/label').

value.description: The value to be associated with this option when selected.

SelectionItem.description: The currently selected values for the component. This can be a literal array of strings or a path to an array in the data model('path', e.g. '/hotel/options').
